name: context-guard
description: Keeps waste out of context without losing anything: blocks re-reads of file text already in context (by line range) and trims noisy command output to its errors, head and tail, saving the full output to a file.

blockRereads.title: Block repeat reads
blockRereads.description: Refuse a Read whose line range is already in context from an earlier read of the unchanged file.

minBytes.title: Ignore files smaller than (bytes)
minBytes.description: Files below this size are never blocked; a refusal costs more than re-reading them.

trimOutput.title: Trim long command output
trimOutput.description: Cut long Bash output down to errors, warnings, the head and the tail. The full output is saved under .claude/context-guard/ and its path is given to Claude.

maxChars.title: Trim output longer than (characters)
maxChars.description: Output at or under this size is never touched.
